product.title: Immersive Boulder Flatiron Hike

description.text: Explore the world renowned Boulder Flatirons up close and personal. Preston, a Boulder local, will help you escape into the foothills of the Rockies and help you connect to the natural landscape through storytelling and conversations about the local flora fauna and history of the Flatirons. Stops include Chautauqua Trailhead, Flatirons Trails. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on Boulder's foothills scenery, open-space trails, and downtown highlights. Ideal for visitors basing in Boulder who want a guided Front Range experience without coordinating meeting points, trailheads, or photo locations on their own.

highlights: Immersive Boulder Flatiron Hike from Boulder
